quests.title: Bread Before Banners
quests.text: The officers can argue over banners once our drivers get the bread through. Kill five Mire-Cured Husks by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/floodmeadows}, which lie {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/floodmeadows}; they keep dragging themselves out of the mud into the carts' path. I'd like to count returning drivers tonight, for a change.
quests.lesson: Front entry: a day hunt in the easiest belt, by the middle road.

quests.title: The Night Shift Never Left
quests.text: Daylight gets the husks moving; night brings out the Tollroad Skeletons in the {name:front_broken_causeway/floodmeadows}. Kill five of those skeletons after dark, before our dawn carts set out. Nobody should have to pay a toll to a man who's outlived his pockets.
quests.lesson: The same ground at night holds a different roster; one outing serves both.

quests.title: What the War Left Standing
quests.text: My father called that war finished, but the {name:front_broken_causeway/battlefield}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/battlefield}, seems to have missed the announcement. Go by day and put down five of the Mire-Cured Husks and Causeway Brigands picking over it. We still need a way through the ground they died fighting over.
quests.lesson: The middle belt: harder mobs, one step farther from the road.

quests.title: Toll Collectors in the Alderwood
quests.text: The coins you brought from the wheelbreak carry a burnt ring, and my drivers have seen that ring before, on the brigands who charge them for the alderwood road. Defeat five Causeway Brigands or Coal-Purse Factors by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}. The factors are the soot-black ones with the warm purses; the brigands only work for them.
quests.lesson: Forest kinds: brigands by day, wolves by night.

quests.title: Cinderline Still Stands
quests.text: Speak with Alna Archsight at Archshadow Post in Stormvault Heights and give her our report: Cinderline Watch still stands. Show her the burnt coins as well; her runesmiths read a stamp the way I read weather, and this one worries me. If she asks whether we're cheerful, tell her we're fed; she'll understand.
quests.lesson: Handoff to the harder half of the Causeway.

quests.title: Nobody's Laughing Here
quests.text: Warpack Hyenas have learned that a tired patrol makes easier hunting than a fresh one. Bring down five by day on the {name:front_shattered_line/approaches}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/approaches}. I promised those sentries they'd get home, and I intend to keep it.
quests.lesson: Front entry: packs call each other, pull them one at a time.

quests.title: The Fletchers' Bright Idea
quests.text: The fletchers have requested three Siege Cat Claws, very neatly written and without a single offer to fetch them. Hunt Tallgrass Tigers by day on the {name:front_shattered_line/bluffs}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/bluffs}, and bring the claws to me. I'll see that your name goes on the delivery.
quests.lesson: Highland kinds: big cats by day, scorpions by night.

quests.title: A Sentry Needs Somewhere to Stand
quests.text: My sentries will face an army, but they've asked for somewhere to put their feet. Kill five War-Stinger Scorpions after dark on the {name:front_shattered_line/ramparts}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/ramparts}. Seems a fair request from people who spend all night standing up for us.
quests.lesson: The middle belt of the Line by night.

quests.title: Raiders in the Trenches
quests.text: Both armies dug the {name:front_shattered_line/trenches}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/trenches}, and Siege Skeleton Raiders now man them every night. Break five of them after dark. I would like to hear what our scouts saw out there without first hearing what chased them home.
quests.lesson: The middle belt of the Line at night, before its standard-bearer.

quests.title: Nobody Left to Rally
quests.text: Every night {name:standard_bearer_ninepins} rallies Siege Skeleton Raiders and fire-stained Brandbound Collectors at the {name:front_shattered_line/breach} {dir_from_giver:standard_bearer_ninepins}, on fresh pay for a war that was lost long ago. Defeat five of them after dark and their standard-bearer with them. His standard lies pledged against the next payment at {name:r20_anchor_082}; unpick the stitching, so nobody can borrow against it again.
quests.lesson: Line climax: a named normal leader beside a night roster, toward Skyglass.

quests.title: Group: An End to the Grinding
quests.text: I can hear {name:siege_engine_nine} grinding along the {name:front_shattered_line/siegecrest} {dir_from_giver:siege_engine_nine}, even when I close my eyes; it still grinds forward on orders somebody keeps paying for. Gather a group and destroy that elite war construct. Before you go, learn each other's names; I want everyone answering to them when you get back.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite; the route reaches 50 without it.

quests.title: Bounty: Room for a Lookout
quests.text: The Tallgrass Tigers have picked the {name:front_shattered_line/siegecrest}, which lies {zone_area:front_shattered_line/siegecrest}, for themselves, and I need it for a lookout. Bring down five there by day for a bounty. You can take the job again twenty-five minutes after each turn-in; apparently my sentries and the cats share a taste in views.
quests.lesson: Repeatable hunting bounty, upper Shattered Line by day.

quests.title: A Recommendation with Mud on It
quests.text: Borin Splitbolt needs fighters for Gravesalt Escarpment, and I can think of one who's earned the recommendation. Speak with him at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights and tell him what happened on The Shattered Line. Leave the mud on your boots; Borin trusts that more than a seal.
quests.lesson: Handoff from the 41-50 front to Gravesalt.

quests.title: A Posting at {name:pvp_fortress_accord}
quests.text: The Warmaster at {name:pvp_fortress_accord} needs fighters who know what a frontier posting costs. Report there, {dir_from_giver:pvp_fortress_accord}, for orders against the Throng camps on the Battlegrounds. If anyone asks why I sent you, tell them I prefer recommendations that can carry their own kit.
quests.lesson: Entry: from a 31-40 outpost to the PvP fortress at level 40.

quests.title: The Gate Does Not Salute
quests.text: The Quartermaster's latest requisition has four underlines and very little steel behind it. Bring me four Silversteel Bars for arrowheads and gate bolts. Our gate must hold when the Throng comes calling; looking imposing is a secondary duty.
quests.lesson: Fortress supplies: an ordinary tier-4 bar.

quests.title: Exhibits for the Drill Yard
quests.text: A recruit who has only fought straw tends to expect straw's standards of resistance. Bring me six War Trophies from defeated Throng Guards; any Throng garrison will do. We will put the enemy's kit beside the practice dummies and discuss the difference.
quests.lesson: War Trophies drop only from enemy guards killed by a player (never a player kill).

quests.title: Intelligence with Teeth
quests.text: My scouts are meant to count Throng tents, but lately their reports contain more teeth than canvas. Kill five Warpack Hyenas by day in the {name:front_shattered_line/approaches}, {zone_area:front_shattered_line/approaches}. A scout should finish a report with both boots still occupied.
quests.lesson: Scouting a Battlegrounds zone: a kill quest on its 41-43 kind.

quests.title: Blind the {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_low}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_low}, {zone_area:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_low}, has been counting our patrols with an accuracy I find offensive. Defeat four Throng Guards and the Throng Captain at that camp. Give our riders a chance to cross without becoming somebody else's morning report.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: A Gap at the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_low}
quests.text: The next obstacle to our scouts is the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_low}, {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_low}. Kill four Throng Guards and the Throng Captain stationed there. A gap in their watch gives us room to work; keep your own guard up so we do not hand them one in return.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Dislodge the {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_high}
quests.text: The troops at the {name:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_high}, {zone_area:pvp_camp_broken_causeway_throng_high}, have had time to settle in and learn their ground. Defeat five Throng Guards and the Throng Captain commanding that camp. Respect their preparation, check your own, and spare me the speech about how courage will cover the difference.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Break Ranks at the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}, {zone_area:pvp_camp_shattered_line_throng_high}, keeps the Throng's fighting strength on this front close at hand. Kill five Throng Guards and the Throng Captain there. You know the drill: pick your moment, finish the engagement, and count your wounds before you count your victories.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: No Cover for the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_low}
quests.text: A forest offers plenty of cover, and the Throng is making better use of it than I would like. Raid the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_low}, {zone_area:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_low}, defeating four Throng Guards and the Throng Captain there. My scouts can handle roots and mist; give them fewer enemy sentries to worry about.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Pressure on the {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_low}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_low}, {zone_area:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_low}, gives the Throng a watch on ground our scouts need to cross. Kill four Throng Guards and the Throng Captain at that post. We need breathing room out there, and the enemy has declined to provide it on request.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy picket's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Test the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_high}
quests.text: At the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_high}, {zone_area:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_throng_high}, the Throng has soldiers who know how to fight when the trees swallow every shouted order. Keep a steady hand and defeat five Throng Guards and the Throng Captain in that camp. Settle on your plan before you go; I have yet to see a fern relay a command correctly.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).

quests.title: Reckoning at the {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high}
quests.text: The {name:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high}, {zone_area:pvp_camp_gravesalt_escarpment_throng_high}, anchors the Throng's strength in a country already thick with old graves. Defeat five Throng Guards and the Throng Captain there. War Commander Stonegrudge now fights beside that garrison, so this is a harder assignment than it was; watch your back and bring yourself home.
quests.lesson: PvP camp raid: the enemy war camp's garrison (area-limited; no player kills).
